summary: Completed testing of server.py refactoring (payroll, recipes modules) and Month-wise Payout Grid View for MG tracking. All backend API tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI tests verified all new features are working correctly.

payroll_module_endpoints.details: POST /api/payroll_status, POST /api/salary_preview, POST /api/lock_payroll all working. Note: server.py endpoints require 'center' field in MonthRequest model.

recipes_module_endpoints.details: GET /api/recipes returns categories and recipes. GET /api/bhojan_guru returns bhojanGuru, regionWise, bodyNeedMatrix. GET /api/recipes/search works with query parameter.

payout_summary_api.details: POST /api/center-accounts/payout-summary returns monthly_data array with sales, revenue_share, mg_amount, paid, pending for each month from revenue start date. MG for PB-PERTH is AUD 22,191.27/month as expected.

month_wise_payout_grid_ui.details: Month-wise Payout Grid visible in MG & Payout tab. Shows columns: Month, Total Sales, Revenue Share, MG, Type, Payable, Paid, Pending, Status. Summary cards display Total Revenue Share, Monthly MG, Total Payable, Total Paid, Total Pending. 14 months of data displayed for PB-PERTH.

mg_calculation_display.details: MG Calculation section shows Investment Breakdown (Total Investment, Deductions, Net Investment) and Monthly MG (EMI). For PB-PERTH: Total Investment AUD 20,00,000.00, Net Investment AUD 11,50,000.00, Monthly MG AUD 22,191.27 @ 15% p.a. for 7 years.

payout_comparison.details: Payout section shows MG vs Revenue Share comparison. Higher amount is marked as 'Payable'. For PB-PERTH 2026-03: MG (22,191.27) > Revenue Share (-145.20), so MG is payable.

critical_code_review_comments: Note: server.py has duplicate payroll_status and lock_payroll endpoints that use MonthRequest with 'center' field, while payroll.py module has MonthRequest without 'center'. The server.py endpoints are being used since they're registered first. Consider removing duplicates or aligning the models.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing PB-PERTH center with FR-PERTH franchise for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll, Recipes, and Payout Summary features are all working correctly. The Month-wise Payout Grid displays 14 months of data for PB-PERTH from revenue start date (26 Feb 2025). MG calculation shows AUD 22,191.27/month. WhatsApp integration for Booking Intelligence module is MOCKED.
